(๑•̀ㅂ•́)૭☒|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 39 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Molten]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|It's getting a bit hot in here.|Beginning of Wave 39 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Molten Titan''' is a large [[Enemies|enemy]] which appears in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode. The '''Molten Titan''' has fairly high health, higher than most enemies that appear before it. Luckily, it moves pretty slowly. It also has [[Burn Immunity|Burn]] and [[Stun Immunity]], meaning that stunning towers can only slow it down instead of stunning it. It can be summoned by the [[Molten Boss]]. The [[Mystery Boss]] can also spawn the '''Molten Titan''' upon its death in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode, wave 38 onwards. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current '''Molten Titan''' is identical to its original version, except it has a slash across its forehead, with drooping lines leaking from it. |Original |The original version of the '''Molten Titan''' had flowing orange-red skin, similar to the [[Molten]]. It wore dark cobblestone armor, along with a cobblestone cape. It had cobblestone armbands as well as a cobblestone helmet with orange-red horns coming out. Its torso and legs were black cobblestone and a puddle of lava could be seen on its chest. Fire emitted from its torso. A lava trail was left behind as it walked. It walked with its head tilted downwards. It had a twisted left leg and a drooling zombie face. }} ==Strategy== *High DPS towers such as [[Minigunner]]s, [[Accelerator]]s, [[Turret]]s and [[Ranger]]s can kill the '''Molten Titan''' easily. **The [[Commander]] can also assist these towers in defeating the '''Molten Titan''' by boosting their firerate. *Make sure some of your towers are set to ''First'' instead of ''Strongest'' as they may target the [[Molten Boss]] instead of the '''Molten Titan''', allowing the '''Molten Titan''' to slip through your defense. *Splash damage towers, such as the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] and the [[Pursuit]] can be useful against the '''Molten Titan''' as they normally spawn in hordes. *You can use towers like the [[Sledger]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Warden]] to slow this down. **As this enemy has [[Stun Immunity]], stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down instead of stunning it completely. **Do note that freezing towers and the [[Warden]] will slow down the '''Molten Titan''' for a shorter amount of time because of its large size. *While towers that deal fire damage, like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Trapper]] cannot burn the '''Molten Titan''', they can still deal non-burn damage to it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} OlderMoltenTitan0.png|First version, second animation (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) MoltenTitanPreOverhaul.png|First version, first animation (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyMoltenTitan.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer|'''Molten Titan''' in the game trailer. Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|'''Molten Titan''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} VoidlandsDI1.png|'''Molten Titan''' on a development image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} MoltenTitanOldIndex.png|'''Molten Titan''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Because of the [[Mystery Boss]], the '''Molten Titan''' can appear before its first wave appearance in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. *The '''Molten Titan''' was originally able to heal itself (100 health per second) but this ability has since been removed. *The cape used by the '''Molten Titan''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|215748322|Guardian of the Night Cape}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Molten Titan's''' appearance was based on [https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/615753550626291717/628269790703779850 Molten Guardian], a fan idea of a guardian enemy for the [[Molten Boss]]. *Oddly, the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] calls the [[Molten Boss]] the '''Molten Titan'''; this is likely due to developer oversight. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''13 October 2019''' -
